generalAbilities.name: Stormflight
generalAbilities.description: A kaminari can move in wind with ease. They ignore all difficult terrain from wind and don't need to Maneuver in Flight in high winds.

generalAbilities.name: Stormsight
generalAbilities.description: Wind, precipitation, and clouds don't impair a kaminari's vision; they ignore the Concealed condition from storms, mist, precipitation, and the like.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hurricane Bag
offensiveAbilities.description:
A kaminari's bag holds the four winds. The kaminari unleashes four 20ft Bursts within 60 feet with the effects of a 9th-rank wall of wind. In addition, a creature that enters one of the bursts takes 6d6 Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). The bursts can't overlap. After using this activity the kaminari can't use Hurricane Bag for 1d4 rounds.

If a kaminari creates a column of lighting using Thunder Drums that intersects one of the areas of the wind, the wind explodes in a peal of thunder, dealing 6d10 Sonic Damage damage to creatures in the area of that wall of wind burst. Affected creatures must attempt a Basic DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw save. The kaminari can detonate only one burst per use of Thunder Drums.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage. Failure The target takes full damage and is Deafened for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is deafened permanently.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tempest Tether
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Electricity leaps between two kaminari. The kaminari establishes a connection with another kaminari within 150 feet, and lightning and thunder form a line between the centers of their spaces. For the next minute, a creature that begins its turn in the line or enters the line on its turn takes 4d12 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature can take this damage only once per round, even if it moves through several tempest tethers. If the distance between the kaminari ever exceeds 150 feet, the tether breaks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thunder Drums
offensiveAbilities.description:
The peal of a kaminari's drums bring thunder and lightning. The kaminari summons four 100-foot-tall columns of lightning to strike in 5ft Bursts within 60 feet. These columns can't overlap. Creatures in the burst take 8d12 Electricity Damage damage and must attempt a DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save. The kaminari can't use Thunder Drums again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is Stunned 1.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is Stunned 2.
